about: Tags offered as concept pages and declined by the writer (pipeline/lib/concepts.mjs). A declined tag is offered again once CONCEPTS.reofferFactor times as many briefings carry it. Delete an entry to have the tag offered at the next run.

admin-center.reason: Admin centre names a place where settings live, spanning the Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft 365 and Microsoft 365 Apps admin centres, not one mechanism with its own behaviour, cost or controls. The dependent briefings have nothing in common beyond the portal they use.

admin-controls.reason: Admin controls is a broad category, not one mechanism: the briefings using it cover unrelated settings in Teams, Edge, Purview, Dynamics 365 and Microsoft 365 Copilot, each with its own policy, role and API. Each belongs on the page for its own mechanism.

adoption.reason: Adoption is a broad category, not one mechanism. The tagged briefings cover unrelated features (Teams chat sections, Viva dashboards, maker guidelines), each with its own controls and cost.

ai.reason: "AI" is a broad category, not one mechanism: the briefings span unrelated products (Teams, Power Apps, Purview, Dynamics 365) with different controls and costs. The shared AI billing meter is already explained by the copilot-credits concept page.

analytics.reason: Analytics is a broad category, not one mechanism. The briefings tagged with it cover unrelated products with separate controls and costs, such as Viva Insights, Agent 365 Business Analytics, Power Automate process mining, Teams call and meeting reports, and Dynamics 365.

automation.reason: Automation is a broad category, not one mechanism: the briefings under it cover unrelated features (Power Automate desktop flows and flow groups, agent lifecycle rules, Copilot Studio workflows, journey agents) with different controls and costs. Credit metering is already explained on the Copilot Credits concept page.

cost-management.reason: Cost management is a broad category, not one mechanism. Its Copilot spending policies, Cost Management configuration and consumption views are already explained by the copilot-credits page; the storage meters and flow groups are separate features.

data-governance.reason: Data governance is a broad category, not one mechanism: its briefings cover unrelated controls (Purview DLP, SharePoint sharing links, Dataverse auditing, DSPM, Edge connectors). Power Platform DLP is already explained by the data-policies concept page.

data-lifecycle-management.reason: Data lifecycle management is the name of a Purview solution area, a place where several separate features live (retention, archive mailboxes, Priority cleanup, PST import), not one mechanism. Its core, retention policies, is already explained by the retention concept page.

finops.reason: FinOps names a practice, not one mechanism: the briefings span Copilot Credits, Process licence capacity, pay-as-you-go storage meters and savings rules, each with its own controls. Copilot Credits and spending policies are already explained on /concepts/copilot-credits/ and /concepts/spending-policies/.

governance.reason: Governance is a broad category, not one mechanism. The briefings carrying it span unrelated controls in Purview, Entra, Teams, Planner, Power Pages and Viva Engage, and the mechanisms behind Power Platform and agent governance already have pages such as managed-environments, data-policies and work-iq.

licensing.reason: Licensing is a broad category, not one mechanism: the 24 briefings span Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Platform capacity, Purview, Teams and storage billing, each with its own licences, meters and controls. Metering is already explained by the copilot-credits concept page.

m365-admin-center.reason: The Microsoft 365 admin center is an admin centre, a place where mechanisms live, not one mechanism. Its briefings concern separate controls (agent blocking, billing policies, usage reports, Backup), some already explained by the copilot-credits concept page.

mobile.reason: Mobile is an app type (the iOS and Android clients), not one mechanism. The 13 briefings depend on unrelated controls in Teams, OneNote, Outlook, Power Apps and Power Pages, so a page would only be a list of features.

model-driven-apps.reason: Model-driven apps are an app type, a place where mechanisms live, not one mechanism with its own cost and controls. The briefings depend on separate settings (form fill assistance, row summaries, display density, Work IQ access) that each belong on their own page.

monitoring.reason: Monitoring is a broad category, not one mechanism. The briefings tagged with it cover unrelated features (Microsoft 365 Backup logs, Copilot Credit cost displays, Purview diagnostics, Teams insights, Application Insights) with no shared behaviour, cost or controls.

oversharing.reason: Oversharing names a risk that spans unrelated mechanisms (SharePoint sharing links, site permissions, connector ACLs, maker credentials), not one mechanism with its own behaviour, cost or controls. The parts are covered by existing pages such as sensitivity-labels, agent-identity (maker-credentials) and managed-environments, and by individual briefings.

policy.reason: Policy is a broad category, not one mechanism: the briefings span Teams calling, messaging and events policies, Edge browser policies, SharePoint sharing and Purview scopes, each with its own controls. Data policies and Teams meeting policy already have concept pages.

power-platform-admin-center.reason: The Power Platform admin centre is an admin portal, a place where many separate mechanisms live, not one mechanism. Its controls are better explained by concepts such as Managed Environments, Copilot Credits and data policies.

powershell.reason: PowerShell is a command-line surface used by many unrelated products (Teams, SharePoint, Planner, Entra, Purview), each with its own module and settings, not one mechanism with its own behaviour, cost or controls. The cmdlets belong on the briefings and concept pages for the setting they change.

privacy.reason: Privacy is a broad category, not one mechanism. The briefings tagged with it cover unrelated controls (Teams recording templates, Edge tracking prevention, Purview audit events, Copilot sharing), each with its own settings, licensing and behaviour.

sharing.reason: Sharing is a broad category, not one mechanism: the briefings span agent sharing in Copilot Studio, SharePoint and OneDrive links, Teams screen sharing, Outlook folders and Copilot responses, each with separate controls. Agent sharing limits are already explained by the managed-environments page.

user-experience.reason: User experience is a broad category describing any change to how a feature looks or behaves, not one mechanism. The briefings span Edge, Teams, Viva Engage, Power Apps and Copilot Studio, each with different controls, licensing and costs.

write-actions.reason: Write actions is a kind of behaviour shared by unrelated products (OneNote, Planner, Work IQ, federated connectors), not one mechanism with its own controls or cost. Each depends on its own controls, covered by the existing work-iq, mcp and connectors concept pages.
